answer: The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a oasis seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. A pre-written answer bank as a result goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 31 aliases trips the duplicate check at the pulse gate. Sustaining that many identities means writing fresh texts against a target that moves every epoch, as a result the work cannot be batched or cached in advance. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
